newsitem.title: USA: Cairn setting casing in offshore find.
newsitem.headline: Cairn setting casing in offshore find.

text.p: Cairn Energy USA Inc said on Monday it is setting production casing in a South Timbalier Block 290 exploration well that found over 150 net feet of true vertical thickness oil and natural gas pay in multiple sands.
Development plans are pending while the company reviews future development and exploration opportunities on the total four block complex South Timbalier Blocks 290, 291, Ewing Bank blocks 782, 783.
Working interest owners in these four blocks include Cairn, 40 percent; Norcen Energy Resources Ltd, 35 percent; and Coastal Corp, 25 percent.
Cairn said the discovery well was directionally drilled to 15,830 feet about 50 miles offshore Louisiana in 395 feet of water. The well will be temporarily abandoned for a future completion.

Cairn said it also has a 33 percent working interest in the Main Pass Block 262 No. 3 exploratory well has been drilled to a total depth of 3,990 feet and encountered 48 feet of net gas pay in a single sand.

Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd, the operator, will now subsea complete and tie-back the well to the existing production facility on the block. Production is scheduled to start from this well by early in the first quarter. Cairn, Canadian Occidental and Box Energy Corp have equal stakes in this well.
On West Cameron Block 588 No. 2, Cairn said, electric log analysis proved the target sands to be non-productive in a percent owned, 8,104 feet exploration well, which was plugged and abandoned.
